market_name: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether any headline/official statement corroborates the market move or if it is pure speculative repricing; check EUR/USD and Bund futures for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Compare VGK/FEZ premarket or ETF intraday vs. US large caps to isolate Europe-specific risk-off.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether move is sticking; look at European defense names (Rheinmetall, BAE) for the offsetting rally that would confirm a NATO-structure thesis.
time_plan.6h: Check if official NATO/US government comment has emerged; fade if no confirmation and probability reverts.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate close-of-window return vs. 700bps tradable threshold; document whether the signal led or lagged public reporting.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a US NATO withdrawal would be a profound security shock for Europe, raising the risk premium on European assets (loss of the US security umbrella, higher defense-spending fiscal burdens, elevated geopolitical tail risk vis-a-vis Russia). Broad European equity exposure via VGK would be the most liquid risk-off proxy and should sell off. Magnitude depends heavily on how credible/near-term the signal is.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check if gold spot/GLD is moving in tandem with the probability spike; verify it isn't just a USD or rates move.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check with Treasury yields and DXY to separate haven demand from rate-driven flows.
time_plan.2h: Reassess; if gold fails to bid, the security-shock interpretation is weak.
time_plan.6h: Look for official confirmation or denial; trim view if probability reverts.
time_plan.12h: Measure 12h return; note correlation with the European equity leg and whether magnitude cleared tradable threshold.

predictions.reasoning: A credible signal of US disengagement from NATO is a classic geopolitical safe-haven catalyst. Gold typically bids on heightened geopolitical/defense-order uncertainty and a weaker transatlantic security architecture. It is highly liquid and a cleaner haven than FX in this scenario.

evidence_used: Market question framing: formal US notice of denunciation under Article 13 of the North Atlantic Treaty by end-2026
Resolution explicitly excludes mere exit from integrated command, requiring formal withdrawal notice
Primary topic military_conflict, region United States
General macro linkage: transatlantic security guarantees underpin European risk premia and safe-haven demand
uncertainty_notes: The market is a low-liquidity, long-horizon (end-2026) probability; a 12h move may reflect noise, not information.
A probability spike need not translate into near-term asset moves absent corroborating news.
If the move is driven by a single large speculative trade, there is no fundamental signal.
700bps threshold is very high for a 12h window; most realistic moves fall short unless hard news breaks.

llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied odds of a US NATO withdrawal would signal a transatlantic security shock: European equities would carry a higher risk premium (down) and safe-haven gold would bid (up). Both are highly liquid proxies, but the mapping is uncertain because the market has a long horizon and a 12h move may be speculative noise rather than leaked information. Magnitudes likely fall short of the 700bps tradable bar absent confirming public news.
key_assumptions: A material move in the prediction-market probability reflects new information rather than illiquidity/noise.
US security guarantees are a meaningful component of European equity risk premia and global haven demand.
The chosen ETFs/commodities retain their historical risk-on/risk-off behavior in this scenario.
failure_modes: The probability move is noise or a single speculative bet with no underlying information, so assets do not move.
The scenario is already widely discussed/public, so any move is pre-priced and reverts.
European defense stocks could rally enough to offset broad index weakness, muddying the VGK direction.
Gold's move could be dominated by rates/USD rather than geopolitical haven demand, breaking the proxy.
12h magnitude far below 700bps, making the mapping non-tradable despite correct direction.
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
